tools.name: teams_post_adaptive_card
tools.description: Post an Adaptive Card (drafted work order, completion report, or shift handover summary) with Approve/Edit/View Full Draft actions to a plant/shift channel or to an individual reviewer, for the mandatory human-review-and-approve step before any connector write-back or distribution occurs.

conversation_id.description: Correlation ID linked to the source work_order_ref or evidence record.

tools.name: teams_send_direct_message
tools.description: Send a 1:1 direct message escalation to an on-call technician, maintenance engineer, or shift supervisor — used when a photo assessment returns a discrepancy_flag or a duplicate-submission check flags a possible duplicate, so the escalation is not missed inside a busy channel.

tools.name: teams_get_action_response
tools.description: Retrieve the button-click payload or free-text reply a human reviewer submitted against a previously posted Adaptive Card (e.g., Approve/Edit), correlated by conversation_id, so the orchestrator can route the approval or edit request back to the drafting skill.

tools.name: teams_list_channel_submissions
tools.description: List technician-submitted attachments (voice recordings, notes, repair photos) posted to the dedicated submission channel since a given timestamp, for intake into the multimodal processing pipeline.
